name: Satan's Whiskers
summary: A cocktail bar on Cambridge Heath Road that calls itself Bethnal Green's original neighbourhood cocktail bar. Time Out gave it five stars, and its menu changes often.
crowd: Time Out describes it as a relaxed neighbourhood hangout rather than a high-end cocktail bar.

story.opened: November 2013, according to Top 50 Cocktail Bars; the venue's own website says late 2013.
story.then: Top 50 Cocktail Bars says the opening team had extensive bartending experience, and that the bar was partly a reaction to the kinds of bars opening at that time. Time Out reports it topped the Top 50 Cocktail Bars list in 2019 and 2023 and again in 2025. In July 2026 Time Out says it was named Best International Cocktail Bar at the Spirited Awards in New Orleans.
story.now: The venue's own website says the menu changes daily and that it takes reservations by telephone only; it also runs a bar consultancy service covering drinks, design, systems and training. Time Out says the drinks lean towards classics and modern classics.
story.vibe: Top 50 Cocktail Bars describes a small, dimly lit, 50-seat bar with mostly old-school hip hop in the background. Time Out mentions vintage French posters on the walls and a smartly modish setting.
worth_knowing: Time Out says it was Bar of the Year and Best London & South East bar at the 2026 CLASS Bar Awards.
Top 50 Cocktail Bars says each day's menu also credits the front-of-house staff by name.
Time Out says its menu has stretched to over 400 cocktails.
Time Out says it has taken the top spot in the Top 50 Cocktail Bars list three times.
